results.title: Street Trash
results.overview: A group of homeless misfits must fight for survival when they discover a plot to exterminate every homeless person in the city.

results.title: Girassol Vermelho
results.overview: Girassol Vermelho is a film inspired by Murilo Rubião, a master of Brazilian magical realism, about the journey of Romeu, a man who leaves his past behind in search of freedom. By chance, he arrives in a strange city where an oppressive and pathetic system, which does not allow for questioning, drags him into a series of interrogations and tortures. In this absurd world, Romeo realizes that he has lost his greatest value: freedom. Full of pain and fury, Romeu, delirious, embarks on a new and even stranger journey.

results.title: My Mother Looked Just Like You
results.original_title: My Mother Looked Just Like You
results.overview: Twenty years ago, Sharon's identical twin vanished. Now, a mysterious young woman enters Sharon's life, claiming to be her sister's daughter and bringing with her a revelation that will upend Sharon's whole life.

results.title: Tribe
results.overview: A desperate man lost in the west coast mountains has to reconstruct his past in order to step back from the edge of insanity.

results.title: Everything to Me
results.overview: A girl raised in Silicon Valley in the shadow of Steve Jobs' successful return to Apple, and his huge influence on her imagination, her aspirations and relationships.

results.title: His Name Was Not Listed
results.overview: June 21, 1941. Young lieutenant Kolya Pluzhnikov, having received an appointment to a permanent place of service, arrives in Brest. The crowded waiting rooms of the station and the crowd of people weighed down with luggage do not alarm the young man, filled with joyful hopes. Kolya hurries to the location of his unit - the Brest Fortress... The soldier does not have time to enlist in the personnel of the military, and at four in the morning artillery explosions are heard - the war has begun. He was not enlisted in the ranks of the military personnel of the Brest Fortress, but still took part in the first battle in his life, which lasted ten months.

results.title: The Disinformation Teacher
results.overview: According to a 2021 study by analysts from Palacký University, around ten percent of teachers surveyed had difficulty distinguishing facts from disinformation. In this documentary report, we explore how disinformation can be identified within the education system and how both teachers and students can protect themselves against it.

results.title: Once Upon A Killing Time
results.overview: Once Upon a Killing Time is a chilling descent into the mind of a boy broken by neglect and driven to become something far more terrifying.

results.title: Mary Anning
results.overview: England, 19th century. 12-year-old Mary is passionate about the fossils that she collects and sells with her father. When he accidentally dies near the fossil cliffs, Mary, her brother and her mother struggle to make the payments for the family house, meaning they will probably have to leave the seaside that Maëlys loves so much. But her father left a mysterious message: what was it that he saw on the cliffs before he died? With some help from her friends, Mary will fight to save her home and continue to do what she loves, searching for fossils, in the midst of a society where girls should not ​“behave like men”. Mary doesn’t know it yet, but she’s going to go down in history…

results.title: LIP LXCKED
results.overview: A man wakes up to horrific consequences after a sloppy make out with a mysterious date.

results.title: Walud
results.overview: 2014: Amuna (44) and her husband Aziz (48), an ISIS fighter, live as shepherds in the rural Syrian desert. When he takes a very young, European ISIS convert as his second wife, Amuna's everyday life is thrown into turmoil.

results.title: Malo fait du vélo
results.overview: Julien is autistic and dreams of finding love. His brother Malo is so devoted to him that he writes his messages on his dating app. Until one night, when they cross paths with Mia.

results.title: Copacabana, May 4th
results.overview: In 2024, Madonna performed the biggest show of her career in Rio de Janeiro. The sands of Copacabana welcomed 1.6 million people. This film shows how the city prepared for the event and how fans were impacted, eagerly waiting for May 4 and recalling the causes the singer has championed throughout her life.

results.title: Think of England
results.overview: In 1943, six disparate souls are sent on a secret government mission to produce pornographic propaganda films for the boys on the front, each one struggling under the weight of their own conscience in this war-torn world, and it's not about to get any easier.

results.title: Creature
results.overview: A coming of age documentary-fiction about an adolescent girl Lola who befriends a mysterious creature on the shore of her new hometown. Throughout their day spent together, Lola explores feelings of longing and belonging.

results.title: Dad's House
results.overview: Francesco, a charming and ambitious separated father, picks up his son Mattia from school to spend "their" day together. He manages to transform a perfectly normal and seemingly quiet afternoon into a fun, special, and almost outlandish adventure. However, everything changes in the evening when Francesco drops Mattia off at his ex-wife's house and has to return to his everyday reality—and the bitterness of solitude.
